evidence.title: Warehouses De Pauw announces two data center projects in Ilfov County, Romania

summary: Warehouses De Pauw has announced plans to develop two new data centers in Ilfov County, Romania, expanding its infrastructure footprint. The projects aim to meet growing demand for AI and cloud computing resources in the region.
title: Warehouses De Pauw Launches Two Data Center Projects in Romania's Ilfov County
